name: rankrat
description: Self-hosted MCP server over Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, GA4 and PageSpeed Insights — search analytics, indexing and crawl diagnostics, ranking and opportunity reports, GA4 reporting. Read-only by default, scoped to the properties you configure.

url.title: rankrat URL
url.description: Base URL of your running rankrat server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (same value as RANKRAT_URL).

authToken.title: rankrat bearer token
authToken.description: Bearer token. Only needed if the server was started with HTTP bearer auth configured.
